name: World Food Programme
body: A content security policy starting at default-src 'self', nosniff, and a sitemap named in robots.txt. But the viewport sets user-scalable=no, which blocks pinch-zoom for people who need larger text.
lesson: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag. Let readers zoom.
summary: www.wfp.org scores 82 out of 100 (B). 2 checks fail now, 15 are at risk, and 20 pass. Fix first: 1374 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.

fix.title: 1374 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: ar.wfp.org (932), de.wfp.org (227), zh.wfp.org (91) and 4 more. The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.wfp.org.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: 17 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /media-and-resources, /media-contacts, /annual-country-reports-2025 and 11 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: The sitemap lists 4 pages search engines should not index
fix.fix: List only live, canonical, indexable URLs in the sitemap.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 15 pages read.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 743 ms
Every page has a meta description
Language alternates point at each other
